title: Elixir of Darkvision
summary: Drink as a Bonus Action to see in the dark up to 40 ft until your next Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle for 40 ft of Darkvision until your next Long Rest.
fields.Crafting: Combine Essence of Crystalline Lens with any Salt.
fields.Creative use: Give it to a scout before exploring an unlit area.
fields.Base value: 25 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added source-reviewed native BG3 gameplay, consumption, and crafting details.
